meaning: Bounded-depth symbolic execution and k-induction projective tower benchmark across 5 model families (m_k in {2, 4, 8, 16}, X_reach = [0, 10]): Phase 1 separates fractional coset obstruction on 3x + 1 == 0 (thread [1, 1, 5, 5], x_inf = -1/3 in Q \ Z -> L = 1, E_g = 0, Delta_E = -1), Phase 2 separates out-of-carrier signed integer lift on 3x + 3 == 0 (thread [1, 3, 7, 15], x_* = -1 in Z \ [0, 10] -> L = 1, E_g = 0, Delta_E = -1), and Phase 3 verifies in-carrier stabilized reachable lift on 3x - 6 == 0 (thread [0, 2, 2, 2], x_* = 2 in [0, 10] -> L = 1, E_g = 1, Delta_E = 0).
